d: On July 29, 2024, 28-year-old Nepali nurse Mamta Kafle Bhatt had a routine video call with her mother from Virginia, USA, before vanishing without a trace. Her husband, Naresh Bhatt, claimed she abandoned their 11-month-old daughter and left home. However, forensic evidence on an electric saw, unusual Tesla movements, increased water usage, and chilling Google searches unraveled a sinister plot behind her disappearance. Watch this episode of Wanted to uncover how investigators and courtroom testimonies exposed Naresh Bhatt’s shocking confession and brought justice for Mamta.
